description: Infrabel staff breakdown by gender is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Staff paid by Infrabel, expressed in number of persons and divided by gender.Disclaimer: The statistics in this dataset are presented on a monthly basis, but are updated every morning after internal recalculations. It is therefore possible that the figures differ slightly, both for the current period - if given - and for previous periods. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Human resources. The portal shows 208 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
